Definition: to precipitate or hurl (rush) headlong; (intransitively) to be rash
BiblicalUsage: 1) to precipitate, be precipitate, push headlong, drive recklessly; 1a) (Qal) to precipitate, wring out, be precipitate
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
